description: BWV 1043, II. Largo ma non tanto, measures 1-15 plus the final downbeat of m.16. 'piano' is the part the visitor plays (solo violin II); 'violin' is the accompaniment (solo violin I).
qn: score position in quarter notes from the start (a 12/8 measure = 6 quarter notes)
hmm_states_note: sil = silence before/after the piece, note = piano note k (0-based index into 'piano'), rest = the rest after piano note k (only rests longer than 0.2 quarter notes)
